senses.gloss: (= (= אִין if; לי = לָא not; מא quidem, somehow) unless, but for (followed by ש־; cmp. אִלְמָלֵא I).
units: <cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 18:20">Num. R. s. 18</cite>, end <he>אי׳ מֵי … שמעמ׳ וכ׳</he> but for the sticky substance in the nose intercepting the evil smell.

senses.gloss: (= אִילּוּ־מָא if somehow) if (ruling the verb without mediation of a relative; cmp. אִלְמָלֵא 2). Ib. א׳ תופשת וכ׳ if (the harsh ringing sound) should take a permanent hold of his ear, it would be bound up (with his body, sub. בלבו as in Tanḥ. Ḥukkath 1, where our w. is substituted by אִלְמָלֵא).
